name: Jump Space Joyride
storyline:
Everyone to stations: Navigation, Command, Security, and Life Support. They all matter, and none of them came with a manual. Except this one... Does anyone read Gargalec?

Locked doors. Coded panels. Keycards stashed in places that made sense to someone, once. Split up, stay loud, and don't lose anyone in the vents.

Haul safes. Empty lockers. Yes, even the kids' drawings on the wall. Some buyer at the next port pays surprisingly well for hand-drawn children's art.
summary:
A 1-4 player co-op heist game where you steal an alien spaceship, escape your pursuers, and loot everything that isn't bolted down. The controls are in alien. Good luck!

Congratulations on stealing your first spaceship! The owners would like a word with you. The buttons aren't in a language you recognize! Figure it out before they catch up, with friends, or flying solo.
